requirements.description: Daily watchman: responsible for verifying fishing compliance and enforcing penalties.

knows: Their duties include checking fishers' hours and catch weight.
They must enforce penalties for non-compliance.

requirements.description: Communal ledger: records fishing logs, scale readings, penalties, and pit deposits.
Watchman inspects a fisher's departure/return logs and scale readings.
If non-compliant, calculate excess and assign 5-minute penalty.
Watchman enforces penalty consequences if work not completed.
Daily watchman role rotates every week.
Communal ledger entries visible to all fishers regarding fishing bans.

knows: Which fishers are currently banned from fishing
remembers: Past ban statuses of other fishers
observes: Current ban statuses through ledger entries

source_coverage.source_clause: Before a fisher leaves the dock, the watchman checks the fisher’s recorded hours and net weight on the communal scale; if hours >4 or weight >3kg, the watchman records the excess, orders the fisher to remove the excess fish to the communal pit, and assigns 5 minutes of net cleaning or fish washing.

The fisher must complete the work within the time limit; if not, the watchman records a 10-minute penalty or imposes a 24-hour ban, locks the fisher’s boat, logs the ban, and notifies the village leader and council.
All logs, scale readings, pit deposits, and penalties are recorded in the communal ledger and verified daily by the watchman.
